name: Áed Álainn
text: Áed Álainn, the beautiful one in Irish, was the husband of Bébinn in the genealogical tradition. MacKillop reads the form as the consort named in the Bébinn headword and points readers there. The principal record sits under the Bébinn headword.

attributes.attribute: Husband of Bébinn; the beautiful one

okr.objective: Áed Álainn is a MacKillop signpost to Bébinn.
key_results: Cites Bébinn as the canonical headword.
Irish epithet meaning the beautiful one.
